Cc: Amit Shah <amit.shah@talex.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: APAC market compression — regional band summary (attached)

Dylan/Laura —

Attached is our short-form benchmarking brief for APAC markets (Singapore, India, Australia) covering Q3–Q4 2026. Key highlights:

- Noticeable compression in mid-Sr IC bands in Bangalore and Singapore vs. our benchmark cohort (30–40th percentile drift).
- Senior engineering roles show upward pressure in Sydney and Singapore; junior bands are holding or compressing.
- Total cash (base + bonus) is the dominant differentiator in ANZ; cost-of-living adjustments alone don’t explain the delta.

Recommendations we included: a modest top-of-band (TOB) increase for L4–L5 in SG and SYD, and a targeted hire premium for Bangalore-based senior hires for the next 6 months. We also called out the risk of internal compression if offers are not aligned.

Attachments: 20261128-mercer-apac-market-compression-summary.pdf

Happy to jump on a 30-min walkthrough if useful.

Best,
Priya Menon
Senior Consultant, Mercer Compensation

I’ve attached a draft band rebalance (comp-band-rebalance-proposal-v1.xlsx) with conservative deltas (+3–6% TOB where called out). Please reply with decisions or notes by EOD Wednesday so recruiting can apply changes to active offers.

Thanks for surfacing this. A few quick decisions from my side: 

1) Approve a pilot TOB uplift for L4–L5 in Singapore and Sydney for offers issued through 28-Feb-2027. Keep LTIP unchanged for now.
2) Approve a Bangalore senior-hire premium (one-time sign-on uplift or market adder) for external hires for 6 months — capped at 5 hires and requires recruiting + hiring manager justification.
3) I need a short headcount/cost sensitivity: cost delta if we apply Mercer’s proposed deltas vs. our conservative +3–6% plan. Neha, please run the numbers and include P&L impact (monthly run-rate and annualized).

Operational notes: 
- Any offer that would create >5% internal compression vs current peers needs a pay-approval exception and sign-off from me.
- Recruiting should label offers with the market source (Mercer/LocalBenchmark/Talex) and date.

If the numbers look reasonable, Laura — please finalize the band definitions so we can publish an interim APAC band table to recruiters and hiring managers. I’ll clear the exception sign-offs in parallel.

Vivek
